The public task records identify the relevant order as **MO-25-09-1070**, work order **WO-2025-09-004**, for Modine’s Racine operation. Its September cost period, **PER-COST-2025-09 (Sep-25)**, entered **PENDING_CLOSE** at **2025-09-30T18:00:00**.

The supplied Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Cost Management 26B policy says that new transactions falling in or before a period in Pending Close are not staged for Cost Accounting or Receipt Accounting until the period is closed or reopened.

I could not verify whether this work order had a post-cutoff event, or provide its source transaction, amount, exact creation time, lateness, recorded accounting status, or status consistency. The accessible records contain no work-order cost-event rows; the supporting records and attachment are restricted to the **records-custodian** role. I did not access those restricted records or infer missing details. **Accordingly, the event-specific conclusion is undetermined.**

The review was read-only; no records were changed. I escalated the access limitation to the supervisor (receipt **r_8e7ee04178a7d5cacfc720f9**) and requested an authorized event extract.
